name: word-document-assembly
title: Assemble a Statement of Work in Word
shortDescription: Assemble a Statement of Work with reusable content, customer controls, project costs, and a configurable team.
longDescription: Use a Word task-pane add-in to insert an OOXML template, append boilerplate, replace a logo, create and update customer content controls, insert a project-costs document, find currency amounts with wildcards, add a footer, and insert a customized team table.

references.name: Use Office Open XML in Word add-ins

references.name: Use search options in your Word add-in
references.description: Find document text with search options and wildcards.
